attributes.action: Proposal to modernise animal welfare enforcement
attributes.additional_details: Introduce a secure, automated, and privacy‑compliant vetting system built on Northern Ireland’s existing dog licensing and microchipping infrastructure. Instead of a public blacklist, it establishes a digital “greenlist” through a PetPass NI framework. Proposed solution to include; 1) Automated Vetting 2) Instant QR Approval 3) Mandatory Point‑of‑Sale Scan via QR code before any transfer of ownership 4) Microchip databases cannot register a change of ownership without a valid registration
attributes.background: Proposal to modernise animal welfare enforcement and prevent convicted abusers from re-acquiring animals via an automated 'PetPass NI' framework

rejection.details:
Decisions about animal welfare legislation, dog licensing, microchipping requirements, and the regulation of pet ownership in Northern Ireland are devolved to the Northern Ireland Assembly and Northern Ireland Executive.

If you want to raise this issue you could contact your MLA, or raise it with the Northern Ireland Executive.

You can find contact details for your MLAs here: http://www.niassembly.gov.uk/your-mlas/

You can find contact details for the departments of the Northern Ireland Executive here: https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/contacts/government-departments-in-northern-ireland
